notes.title: Eiyu*Senki GOLD Releases Today!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31027837/a4217236f5ee40967a5abfe4cc42356d1ec7efb1.jpg[/img]

Hello Everyone!

If you enjoyed the original [i]Eiyu*Senki[/i], then you won't want to miss the newest title in the series, [b]Eiyu*Senki GOLD[/b]! The game will be releasing on Steam June 25th, later today! If you haven't added the game to your wish list, now is the best time, so [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1518430/EiyuSenki_Gold__A_New_Conquest/]go to the store page to check it out![/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1518430/EiyuSenki_Gold__A_New_Conquest/

Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/jast]follow us on Steam[/url]! You can also [url=https://twitter.com/jastusa]check out our Twitter[/url] to get our latest news and ramblings. Want to chat with other visual novel fans? Come [url= https://discord.gg/rMGjzQE]hang out on Discord[/url]!
